sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_definitions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "city" TEXT NULL, "issuer" TEXT NULL, "issued_at" TEXT NULL, "code" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "card_type" TEXT NULL, "needs_completion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("needs_completion" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("version" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_definitions (id), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("quantity" > 0), "acquired_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("version" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_images" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_items (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "derived_relative_path" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_cover" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_cover" IN (0, 1)), "checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_count" INTEGER NULL, "count_known" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("count_known" IN (0, 1)), "issue_info" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "cover_image_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES card_images (id), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("version" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((count_known = 0 AND expected_count IS NULL) OR (count_known = 1 AND expected_count > 0)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_set_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "set_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_sets (id), "definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_definitions (id), "member_no" TEXT NULL, "required" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("required" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("version" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("version" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_tags" ("tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), "definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_definitions (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("tag_id", "definition_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "series_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("version" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "series_cards" ("series_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES series_records (id), "definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_definitions (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("series_id", "definition_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "series_sets" ("series_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES series_records (id), "set_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_sets (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("series_id", "set_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_field_definitions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("version" > 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_field_values" ("field_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES custom_field_definitions (id), "definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_definitions (id), "text_value" TEXT NULL, "number_value" REAL NULL, "date_value" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("field_id", "definition_id"), CHECK ((text_value IS NOT NULL) + (number_value IS NOT NULL) + (date_value IS NOT NULL) = 1));
CREATE INDEX idx_card_set_members_set_sort ON card_set_members (set_id, sort_order)
